description: Top-level site/app navigation primitive. HTML-first wrap or JSON-first .items setter; auto aria-current sync via URL matching (origin + normalised pathname) on popstate and Navigation API entry changes.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the navigation region.

attributes.name: data-match
attributes.description: Pathname matching strictness. 'exact' requires exact match. Default: exact wins, longest prefix breaks ties, first-in-DOM-order breaks remaining ties.

attributes.name: data-label-new-tab
attributes.description: Screen-reader suffix appended to external .items links. Default: '(opens in new tab)'.

properties.name: items
properties.type: Array<{ href, label, route?, icon?, external?, badge? }>
properties.description: Read returns the last assigned array, else { href, label } inferred from the managed links. Assigning replaces the direct <a> children with the default renderer (deep-equal assignment is a no-op). Only http(s) and relative hrefs render as links.

properties.name: current
properties.description: Read returns the active route (data-route or href of the aria-current link, or the explicit value). Assigning takes ownership: URL sync stops until releaseCurrent().

methods.name: releaseCurrent()
methods.description: Drop explicit ownership of .current and re-run URL matching.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-run URL matching manually (for routers that change the URL without popstate or the Navigation API). No-op while .current is explicitly owned.

events.name: nav-bar:upgraded
events.description: Fired after every connect, including reconnects after a move.

events.name: nav-bar:items-changed
events.description: Fired after .items is assigned a new (not deep-equal) value.

events.name: nav-bar:current-changed
events.description: Fired when the active link changes.

childAttributes.name: href
childAttributes.description: Standard anchor href. Resolved against the document base URL and matched by origin + normalised pathname (trailing slash, query and hash ignored).

childAttributes.name: data-route
childAttributes.description: Optional .current target. Falls back to href when absent.

childAttributes.name: data-nav-link
childAttributes.description: Marks a descendant <a> as a candidate for active-state matching when the link list is wrapped (e.g. inside <li> or <drop-down>). When any descendant carries this attribute, those replace 'direct children' as the candidate set. When none of them matches the location but a link nested beside one does (a menu item in the same <drop-down> or <li>), that one gets aria-current="true" as the current section.
